published.title: Zimri's Coup and Omri's Rise
published.summary: Zimri murders Elah and destroys Baasha’s household. The army makes Omri king and besieges Tirzah; Zimri burns the royal house over himself and dies. After a struggle with Tibni’s supporters, Omri reigns and builds Samaria.
